scope: ColorPicker only: 24 Linux Chromium cases, 32 original PNGs. Eighteen default closed-trigger cases across three sizes and six design/mode configurations; six failed 200% cases with six full-viewport control frames and eight automatic diagnostic PNGs.
decision: partial default closed-trigger review; all six zoom acceptance results remain pending after the failed alpha expectation

observations.detail: The MD3 controls frame only shows the leading portion of the complete eight-digit HEX inside its single-line value input. Apple/shadcn frames show the full initial value. This is not by itself evidence of lost data or an inaccessible control.
observations.recommendation: In the new native candidate verify the complete value and accessible label, Home/End caret movement and keyboard selection across the entire value, then capture the reachable actions after real scrolling. Retain design typography and normal horizontal input scrolling; change product layout only if those interactions or necessary controls are actually unreachable.

observations.detail: Six automatic failure screenshots are cropped by the known true-tab-zoom Page screenshot limitation. They are preserved as raw diagnostics and excluded from full-view appearance acceptance. They do not invalidate the separately captured complete CDP viewport PNGs.
Two additional shadcn automatic screenshots are blank. They contain no component appearance evidence and are not counted as accepted component images.

pending: All six zoom cases failed before confirmation/actions coverage; a fixed-source run and new review are required.
The lower presets/actions are not fully shown in the first controls frame; a real scrolled/actions frame is still required.
No Firefox/WebKit results for ColorPicker in this run.
The other six owned packages did not run in this candidate; no result is inferred for Select, Dialog, Drawer, DropdownContainer, Tooltip or Menu.
Other core states, densities, environment extensions, nested format-menu appearance, native EyeDropper session and dynamic behavior are outside this review.
No baseline creation/update or verified/lifecycle change.
